items.t: Four-speed automatic slips or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace four-speed automatic transmission
items.note: 4L80-E heavy-duty units cost more.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Van engine access through the doghouse adds time.

items.t: Central "spider" fuel injector sticks or leaks
Fuel pump keeps failing
items.note: Long-wheelbase vans with bigger tanks take longer.

items.t: 4.3L V6 burns oil
items.job: Oil consumption diagnosis and PCV service
items.note: Ring replacement, if needed, costs much more.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts
items.job: Extract broken bolts, replace manifold bolts and gasket

items.t: Duramax diesel overheats when working hard
items.job: Replace fan clutch and clean radiator and intercooler

items.t: Clogged diesel particulate filter
items.job: Clean diesel particulate filter and change oil

items.t: Diesel high-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump, injectors, lines and flush fuel system
items.note: If caught before debris spreads, only the pump may need replacing.

items.t: 8-speed automatic shifts hard, slips or won't go into gear
items.job: Replace transmission valve body or spacer plate kit
items.note: Some cases are covered by a GM program; a full replacement costs far more.

items.t: Transmission software can cause harsh shifts or wheel lockup (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Fuel pump control module fails and engine stalls
items.job: Replace fuel pump power control module
items.note: Free on vans covered by GM's program.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak
items.job: Locate leak with dye and replace seal or gasket
items.note: Usually covered by the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Drive belt squeals or breaks
Driver door impact beam may be poorly welded (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Passenger head restraint may be poorly welded (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: 2.8L diesel turbo whine or oil at turbo ducts
items.job: Tighten duct clamp or replace turbocharger
items.note: The low end is just a clamp; turbo replacement is the high end.

items.t: ABS module fails and replacement parts are scarce
items.job: Replace or rebuild ABS control module
items.note: Rebuilt modules can cost less if new parts are unavailable.

items.t: Brake line can rub on a body mount
items.job: Repair brake line section and reroute

items.t: Driver window switch can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Rear climate control can short and overheat (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Tires may lose tread or blow out (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Battery cable can short against the fuse block (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Transmission can drop into neutral
items.job: Reprogram transmission control module (GM service update)
items.note: Free under the GM service update.

items.t: Van can roll away after leaving Park (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Alternator voltage regulator can short and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Transmission defect can strand the van (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Steering linkage or wheel bearing nuts may loosen (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Brake booster seal can fail (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Rusted fuel filler pipe can leak (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Power steering cooler hose can leak onto the engine (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Fuel odor or fuel leak (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Steering gear nut may not be tightened (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Unused rear heater wiring can overheat on cutaway vans (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
